name: reqifsharp-sage
description: Sage is the AI agent of the reqifsharp ecosystem: grounded answers about the OMG ReqIF 1.2 standard (metamodel, XML schema, normative specification text), the prostep ivip ReqIF Implementation Guide (when you import your own copy), and the reqifsharp C# library's API, plus inspection of .reqif/.reqifz files.

hooks.command: case "$(uname -s)-$(uname -m)" in Linux-x86_64) exec "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/native/linux-x64/reqifsharp-sage-hook" ;; Darwin-arm64) exec "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/native/osx-arm64/reqifsharp-sage-hook" ;; MINGW*|CYGWIN*|MSYS*) exec "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/native/win-x64/reqifsharp-sage-hook.exe" ;; esac
